requirements.text: 5+ years experience designing and engineering scalable frontend architectures – creating reusable component libraries, leveraging principled state management patterns, and optimizing for performance.
Deep expertise with Typescript, React, HTML5, CSS3, and related technologies.
Proficiency with build tools like Webpack and Vite.
Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with a demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
Experience working with containerization technologies (e.g. Docker) as well as orchestration tools (e.g. Kubernetes) to deploy web applications at scale.
Experience leveraging CI/CD to enable experimentation and safe deployment strategies.
Experience leveraging AI for code generation and building features.
Experience developing applications for healthcare or related fields.
Work Model: We have a hybrid work model with 3 days onsite each week (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday).
